args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation for local MinIO setup
args.body:
File: README.md

Step 2 of "Running locally" suggests MinIO as the quickest option for the S3-compatible store but never mentions that `S3_ENDPOINT` (e.g. `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000`) must be set, causing uploads to default to AWS S3. Add a line in step 2 or 3 noting this setting, and a note that the bucket must be created in the MinIO console before uploading.

file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The "Running locally" steps mention MinIO as the quickest S3-compatible store but never say to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (e.g. `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000`), so uploads default to AWS S3 and fail with ENOTFOUND. Step 2 or 3 should add a line about this setting, plus a note that the bucket needs to be created in the MinIO console first.
